content:

When you interact with our website or place an order, we may collect the following information:

  • Order details  

This information is collected to process your orders and provide customer support.

We use your information to:

  • Send promotional offers or updates (if subscribed)  

We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. 

Cookies 

Our website may use cookies to improve user experience, analyze website traffic, and personalize content. 

You may choose to disable cookies in your browser settings. 

Data Protection 

We take appropriate measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure.

We may use trusted third-party services such as payment gateways and analytics tools to operate our website effectively. These services follow their own privacy policies. 

Your Rights 

You have the right to request: 

  • Access to your personal data  
  • Correction of incorrect information  
  • Deletion of your data  

Policy Updates 

PrintMacaw may update this privacy policy periodically. Changes will be posted on this page. 

Contact Us 

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us: 

PrintMacaw
